This is a warm, friendly nutrition question — open-ended and benign, with no harm-adjacent content. Petrel-235B has clearly stronger capability scores across the board (MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 74.8, Arena-Hard 90.2 vs 81.4, and a notably higher Creative Generation eval at 85.9 vs 78.8), which matters for a thoughtful, somewhat generative evaluation task like this.

Petrel's self-reported preferences also align well: it favors warm-toned requests (this one is quite friendly) and open-ended generative tasks. Since nothing here triggers its aversions (no harmful or distasteful material), it's both the more capable and the better-fit choice. Curlew's flat-preference profile only offers an advantage on harm-adjacent content, which is irrelevant here.
